title: The Stillness That Became Itself

features.name: still-pool
features.desc-on-touch: The surface holds no ripple, no reflection. You see only the dark that learned to stay.

features.name: ordered-rows
features.desc-on-touch: The plantation extends in perfect rows, each marked with a glyph that learned the meaning of place.

features.name: the-rested-weight
features.desc-on-touch: Stones or soil packed and settled, the earth's own breath made still.

features.name: unmoving-light
features.desc-on-touch: A warmth persists here, amber in the deep. It learned to glow without ever reaching.

features.name: the-threshold-of-arrival
features.desc-on-touch: A marker carved or grown, the place where movement learned it could stop.

inscription: stillness is not the end of motion; it is motion learning that it has always been here

file.name: Orchard_Dusk_Where_Nothing_Leaves_1994.txt
file.note: A local farmer's log from a night they chose to stay, discovered decades later filed as poetry

reverie.title: REVERIE — the orchard where staying became possible
narr: You sit among the rows. Katita sits beside you, her
breath matching the cicadas. Neither of you needs to move.
The trees hold their fruit. The dark does not rush. You
understand, for the first time, that arrival means you can
choose to stay. The soil under your palms is warm still.
She takes your hand. The orchard breathes with you both.
